title: BUT WHAT IS YOUR HONEST ANSWER? AIDING LLM-JUDGES WITH HONEST ALTERNATIVES USING STEERING VECTORS
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating and benchmarking LLM honesty, sycophancy, and manipulative behavior. It introduces a 'Manipulation Dataset' consisting of various ethical categories like False Credentials, Emotional Manipulation, and Risk Distortion to measure the ability of LLM-judges to detect dishonest patterns.
